ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And We had certainly given Dawud and Sulaiman knowledge. And they said, 'Praise be to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.'

ayahs.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
ayahs.translation_en: And Sulaiman inherited Dawud and said, 'O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things.'

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا
ayahs.translation_en: And to Sulaiman, We subjected the stormy wind, blowing by his command toward the land which We had blessed.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ
ayahs.translation_en: And to Sulaiman, We subjected the wind; its morning course was a month and its evening course was a month. And We caused a fount of molten copper to flow for him.

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, 'O ants, enter your dwellings.'

ayahs.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ
ayahs.translation_en: So he smiled, laughing at her speech, and said, 'My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me.'

ayahs.arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And he checked the birds and said, 'Why do I not see the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?'

ayahs.arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
ayahs.translation_en: But he stayed not long and said, 'I have encompassed that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.'

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ
ayahs.translation_en: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.translation_en: 'Indeed, it is from Sulaiman, and indeed, it is [in the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful].'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'O assembly, which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ
ayahs.translation_en: A powerful one from among the jinn said, 'I will bring it to you before you rise from your place.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ الَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ
ayahs.translation_en: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, 'I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَآهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ
ayahs.translation_en: And when he saw it settled before him, he said, 'This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful.'
